integrity: A complete analytic argument is provided; finite checks are confirmatory and do not substitute for infinite-dimensional proof. Literature comparisons are qualified by accessible evidence.
limitations: Binary hypercube family only; not higher-colour classifications or q-ary Hamming graphs.
No independently conducted expert or external audit.
Unindexed mathematically equivalent edge-sign classification cannot be ruled out.
title: Walsh rigidity of optimal strong-majority edge colourings of hypercubes
